messages:
mira: noticed an odd pattern in the entitlement audit - several service accounts had roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter re-granted within 24h after we removed them last month. looks like automated job rebinds. :confused:

ben: do we have a reproduction query? want to see who performed the regrants and which CI job touched it

mira: query i ran against cloudaudit export (sanitized):

```sql
SELECT
  protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS actor,
  protoPayload.request.metadata.callerIp AS caller_ip,
  resourceName,
  protoPayload.request.@type as req_type,
  TIMESTAMP(protoPayload.timestamp) as ts
FROM `redwood-audit.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_*`
WHERE protoPayload.serviceName = 'cloudkms.googleapis.com'
  AND protoPayload.methodName = 'SetIamPolicy'
  AND TIMESTAMP(protoPayload.timestamp) > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

oliver: nice. any common actor? infra-service@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com?

mira: exactly. infra-service is a legacy deployer for some onboarding flows. it appears a glue job reapplies bindings when the pipeline config sync runs.

sasha: that's the automation we deprecated but never fully retired. plan: add a pre-check in the sync job to honor explicit deny markers in a key's metadata and fail fast instead of reapplying.

ben: before we change automation, we need evidence for compliance. capture: (1) pre-change key policy snapshot, (2) the SetIamPolicy audit event JSON, (3) the job run id that performed regrant. put all in gs://redwood-audit/kms-regrant-investigation/${thread_ts}/

compliance-bot: reminder: any entitlement change must include a 1-line business justification + prior policy blob path.

mira: suggested short justification template we can attach: - pre_policy: gs://redwood-audit/kms-regrant-investigation/${thread_ts}/pre-policy.json - observed issue: repeated automated re-grants by infra-service job after manual removal - mitigation: add deny-tag check to sync job; convert infra-service to scoped principals; schedule phased remove of infra-service KMS perms.

ben: rollback / remediation commands for immediate mitigation (example):

```bash
# snapshot
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/rk/cryptoKeys/master-key \
  --project=PROJ > pre-policy-${thread_ts}.json
gsutil cp pre-policy-${thread_ts}.json gs://redwood-audit/kms-regrant-investigation/${thread_ts}/pre-policy.json

# revoke infra-service binding
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/rk/cryptoKeys/master-key \
  --member='serviceAccount:infra-service@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
  --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter'
```

oliver: instead of immediate revoke, recommend conditional binding to limit blast radius while we patch the sync job:

```yaml
- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
  members:
  - 'serviceAccount:infra-service@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com'
  condition:
    title: temp-restrict-sync
    expression: request.time < timestamp("2026-05-01T00:00:00Z")
```

sasha: i'll push a small change to the sync job tomorrow to skip keys with label `security:locked=true`. also add a dry-run flag and an audit log line for any attempted rebind.

mira: monitoring signals for the canary: any SetIamPolicy on KMS by infra-service, KMS AccessDenied spikes for expected consumers, and pipeline job failures. alert thresholds: any SetIamPolicy by infra-service = pager; >3 AccessDenied by related svcacct in 1h = rollback.

ben: ticket created INFRA-5709 (owner=sasha) to update sync job + add pre-check. sec-bot scheduled a watch on key policies for 14d.

compliance-bot: recorded snapshot requirement: attach pre-policy and SetIamPolicy event JSON. please ensure ticket link in artifacts.

mira: action items: SASHA patch sync job and deploy canary; BEN gather audit events + gs snapshot; OLIVER prepare conditional-binding snippet and rollback copy; MIRA will coordinate compliance justification and close loop. target: patch + canary by 2026-04-06 EOD. :lock: :mag:

ben: will paste the raw SetIamPolicy event JSON and job run id to gs://redwood-audit/kms-regrant-investigation/${thread_ts}/events.json when done.

mira: thanks — keep replies here to preserve the audit trail.
